# ShipDataFast · Financial Data Reconciliation & Migration Assurance

> ShipDataFast is a specialist financial data reconciliation and migration-assurance consultancy helping organisations verify that critical data remains complete and correct across system migrations, integrations and operational platforms.

## Summary

ShipDataFast helps financial-services institutions, fintechs, and technical data teams prove that data has moved correctly between systems. We combine senior consulting expertise with automated reconciliation engineering and proprietary local-first tooling to detect missing, corrupted, duplicate, and mismatched records before they become production problems.

The consultancy is the core business. Our reconciliation and validation tools support consulting delivery and can also operate as software products within client-controlled environments.

## Core Practice Areas

### 01 / Data Reconciliation Consulting
Comparing source and target systems deterministically and explaining every mismatch.
- System & platform migration reconciliation
- Ledger and transaction reconciliation
- Multi-party payment and settlement reconciliation
- Source-to-target mapping & comparison contracts
- Exception classification (missing, transformed, timing, value differences)
- Link: https://shipdatafast.com/services/data-reconciliation/

### 02 / Migration Assurance
Proving data survives migration, transformations, and cutovers intact.
- Completeness and volume checks (e.g. proving all records arrived)
- Transformation validation across disparate source and target schemas
- Pre-cutover and post-cutover verification
- Aggregate ledger and record-level discrepancy analysis
- Link: https://shipdatafast.com/services/data-reconciliation/

### 03 / Data Validation & Engineering
Building automated controls, assertions, and pipelines around critical financial data flows.
- Intake schema validation and mandatory business-rule assertion
- Data quality automation and pipeline regression checks
- Integration contracts for decoupled systems
- Link: https://shipdatafast.com/services/data-engineering/
- Link: https://shipdatafast.com/services/data-validation/

## Specialized Software Products
- **ShipDataFast Reconciliation Engine**: Purpose-built software answering "Where do these datasets disagree?" across corresponding datasets using explicit matching keys, normalization, and numeric tolerance rules.
  - Link: https://shipdatafast.com/products/reconciliation/
- **ShipDataFast Data Validation**: Rule-based evaluation answering "Does this data satisfy its rules?" for single datasets against mandatory presence, patterns, and range bounds.
  - Link: https://shipdatafast.com/products/validation/

## Operational Principles & Differentiators
- **Client-Controlled Perimeter**: Workflows execute within client-controlled infrastructure. Sensitive financial records, account identifiers, and proprietary data do not leave the client's security boundary.
- **Deterministic & Auditable**: Every reconciliation difference traces directly to explicit inputs and configured business rules.
- **Financial-Services Credibility**: Deep experience with transactional systems, ledgers, trading platforms, and market-data feeds where rounding errors and timing cut-offs carry severe operational and regulatory risk.
- **Not Generic IT / Not Just a CSV Tool**: Focused senior engineering delivery solving high-stakes data integrity questions, backed by reusable local-first tooling.

## Commercial Entry Offer
- **Reconciliation Diagnostic**: A bounded first engagement to assess source/target systems, define matching keys, run representative reconciliations, and deliver an auditable discrepancy report with automation recommendations.
